source_context.historical_checklist: Davis and Barnes 1993, The Butterflies of Mauritius; doi:10.5962/p.332210

official_GBIF_backbone.decision: Do not treat 1993 Z. antanossa records as an exact historic match to the accepted GBIF Z. otis 7346444 without a documented taxonomy-concept crosswalk

unusual_occurrence.decision: Flag for image/voucher/local expert review. The recorded location is Mauritian, and a range anomaly is not sufficient proof of error or human transport.

inference_gates: Do not automatically pool Z. antanossa and Z. otis across conflicting accepted-taxonomy concepts.
Do not discard a single geographically unusual occurrence without raw source quality verification.
GBIF occurrence and country records do not establish native origin, breeding, establishment, or endemicity.
The historical source confirmed exactly three Mauritius binomials, with two cases unresolved.
